title: BrickSorter
desc: Stackable nestable sorting sieve for bricks

items.name: FingerJoint_style
items.label: style
items.desc: style of the fingers

items.name: FingerJoint_surroundingspaces
items.label: surroundingspaces
items.desc: space at the start and end in multiple of normal spaces

items.name: FingerJoint_bottom_lip
items.label: bottom_lip
items.desc: height of the bottom lips sticking out  (multiples of thickness) FingerHoleEdge only!

items.name: FingerJoint_edge_width
items.label: edge_width
items.desc: space below holes of FingerHoleEdge (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_extra_length
items.label: extra_length
items.desc: extra material to grind away burn marks (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_finger
items.label: finger
items.desc: width of the fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_play
items.label: play
items.desc: extra space to allow finger move in and out (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_space
items.label: space
items.desc: space between fingers (multiples of thickness)

items.name: FingerJoint_width
items.label: width
items.desc: width of finger holes (multiples of thickness)

items.name: x
items.label: x
items.desc: outer width of the most outer layer

items.name: y
items.label: y
items.desc: outer width of the most outer layer

items.name: h
items.label: h
items.desc: inner height in mm

items.name: level
items.label: level
items.desc: Level of the nestable sieve

items.name: radius
items.label: radius
items.desc: Radius of the corners of the sieve pattern in mm. Enter 30 for circular holes.

items.name: wiggle
items.label: wiggle
items.desc: Wiggle room, that the layers can slide in each other.

items.name: thickness
items.label: thickness
items.desc: thickness of the material (in mm)

items.name: burn
items.label: burn
items.desc: burn correction (in mm)(bigger values for tighter fit)

items.name: format
items.label: format
items.desc: format of resulting file

items.name: labels
items.label: labels
items.desc: label the parts (where available)

items.name: reference
items.label: reference
items.desc: print reference rectangle with given length (in mm)(zero to disable)

items.name: tabs
items.label: tabs
items.desc: width of tabs holding the parts in place (in mm)(not supported everywhere)

items.name: qr_code
items.label: qr_code
items.desc: Add a QR Code with link or command line to the generated output

items.name: inner_corners
items.label: inner_corners
items.desc: style for inner corners

items.name: spacing
items.label: spacing
items.desc: spacing around parts (multiples of thickness [: extra space in mm])

items.name: debug
items.label: debug
items.desc: print surrounding boxes for some structures
